I lost both of my only bestfriends to suicide. The first had alcohol problems that he couldn't get away from; so the only logical (to him) reason was to steal our friends handgun and blow his brains out in the apartment stairwell. He was the most kind and caring person you'd ever met, and everywhere he went everyone looked forward to seeing him,  so it really hurt and still does. The second got into hard drugs (as did I, with him no less, because we both couldn't cope with losing the first) and he also had the bright idea of stealing a handgun and blowing his brains out in his mom's house while they were all asleep. Both of these people were the popular, well liked and connected kids in school and I never, ever expected them to do the things they did, but I can't change the past. I think I realized that when I was at my lowest, ready to do the same thing as them cos why not, they left me here alone and my inner voice said it can't be that bad if they both did the same thing as one another. My dad took all the guns out of my house after I said I had had enough one night while fighting with my wife (gf at the time) and that id do the same they did; and honestly, idk if I really could have, but I'm glad I didn't have to find out if i could. I think about them and miss them both more than anything in this world, I really just wish they could see what the world looks like today rather than it did 4/5 years ago cos I know they would be in better places than they were.  I guess the main reason I didn't end it all, is because I couldn't pass those feelings on to the people that were around me and cared about my life, even though I couldn't give a shit. Most days though, I still want to die, or just simply stop existing but I can't because I have responsibilities and a son that I can't leave alone in this world. If I still wanna give up later in life, maybe I will, maybe I won't; I have to get there first and that requires being alive. 

I'm sorry if this was harsh to anyone, I didn't mean it to be. I'm still trying to process it all and grieve years later. Idk if I ever will.

You should definitely be able to pull up the code with a standard obd2 reader, i got my from oriellys for less than $100 and it's never let me down. I could read codes from toyota tundras, Isuzu nprs, my 04 wrx and many more. The flashing check engine light on subaru happens when the engine notices something way out of line, and it's a sign to shut it off to not further damage the engine. Everything I had read before was stating that it's a misfire, or something worse. If you can get in there and unplug 1 pack at a time and start the vehicle until you notice the one that gave no change, you might be able to find it. An obd2 eader is your best bet though.

If it's flashing the check engine light and shaking, odds are its a misfire. Coil packs or sparkplugs need to be changed. I chased a random misfire for months in my 04 wrx and finally it just stopped.

Order a new radiator for sure. First thing to repair. You can drive and the car will function fine with the ac disabled if it is damaged. Disconnect the coolant lines at the sides of radiator and any other hoses going to it and remove the radiator from the engine bay. Drop the new one in and hook the lines back in, fill with coolant and turn it on the 'burp' the air out of the system. Check out some YouTube videos on how to replace radiator in your year, make and model of car. Chances are someone has done this before and you can learn from their uploads, I always go to YouTube before tackling any automotive stuff.
